title: new sprint gives its goal research story a check that passes before any research
goal: The goal research story that backlog.py new sprint files carries a check that fails until the research has written its output (for example a commit naming the story in KB-Work that changes kb content, or a findings entry it names), so precheck and intake's drift detector stop reporting the four planned sprints' research stories (ST-3xjmzebr, ST-72zlasrp, ST-oolpcwu6, ST-tudbg2a6) as already passing; found by intake draft ST-lfc42m76.

run: import subprocess,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_items;r=[subprocess.run(c['run'],capture_output=True).returncode for c in bl_items.RESEARCH_CHECKS];print('research checks before any research:',r);sys.exit(1 if all(x==0 for x in r) else 0)

gates.question: What check does the goal research story that new sprint files carry instead of check.py, given ST-idwjvloy's No outside facts route?
options: commit or note: passes when a commit with KB-Work naming the story changes a non-item file, or its notes hold No outside facts: <reason>
kb content commit only: passes only on a KB-Work commit changing kb/public/**
gates.recommendation: commit or note: passes when a commit with KB-Work naming the story changes a non-item file, or its notes hold No outside facts: <reason>
gates.answer: commit or note: passes when a commit with KB-Work naming the story changes a non-item file, or its notes hold No outside facts: <reason>
